name: Robledo de Corpes (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white above and crimson red below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Robledo de Corpes (a tree, a mount and a goat above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Robledo de Corpes; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
